consensus_binding.summary: Validators bind the stored price by exact quantization-bucket equality and the stored confidence by exact match. The stored price is the bucket midpoint, derived from the bucket rather than from the leader's raw median, so two accepted outputs for one request cannot differ.
consensus_binding.bucket_notation: idx@step_atto - the price is the midpoint of [idx*step, (idx+1)*step)

ring_capacity.summary: Every PriceFeed fixes its ring capacity when it is created and keeps it for life. _cap(feed) is the single definition of the ring width, used by the writer and by get_latest_price / get_price_history / get_twap alike. max_history seeds NEW feeds only and can no longer reach a live one.
ring_capacity.bug_fixed: Reads derived the width from len(history) while the writer derived it from the mutable global max_history. Changing max_history under a feed that already held records split the two apart and corrupted reads in BOTH directions.
ring_capacity.shrink_case: max_history 10 -> 5 over a 10-record feed: writes landed at count % 5 while reads still walked all 10 slots, so get_latest_price returned seq 10 with seqs 11-15 already written and unreachable.
ring_capacity.grow_case: max_history 4 -> 12 over a wrapped feed: the writer appended past the ring while reads rotated around the cursor, so history came back out of time order (3, 6, 5, 7, 4) and seq 3 was named latest with seq 7 written. Rejecting only a smaller max_history would have left this live.
ring_capacity.why_no_migration_hook: Compacting a live ring on resize means an owner-callable path that rewrites stored price records, contradicting claim 1 of the trust model. It is also unbounded work - pairs grows with every pair ever requested - so an eager migration could exceed the block gas limit and brick the parameter.
ring_capacity.trade_stated: An existing feed cannot be deepened without deploying a new contract.

supersedes.reason: prior build read the ring width from the mutable max_history global on the write path and from len(history) on the read path
